question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP tools/list request with no initialize handshake (jsonrpc 2.0, id 1, method tools/list, no params), Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream; section (P1) of the artifact, sent 18:10:20Z

decoded.challenge: byte-for-byte the challenge the 2026-09-21 record of this request recorded, and the one an initialize drew on 2026-09-17: invalid_token, a description, the protected-resource metadata URL, no realm
decoded.response-size: 699 bytes, headers and body, as received
decoded.why-re-sent: Re-sent 2026-10-09 because the record of this request from 2026-09-21 (p-20260921-vercel-mcp-tools-list-anonymous) was filed before this prober kept transcripts and names no artifact; this one does. Nothing measured changed.

finding: An anonymous tools/list to the Vercel MCP endpoint answers 401 with the same Bearer challenge and the same JSON error body it answered on 2026-09-21 and that an initialize drew on 2026-09-17, so eighteen days on the endpoint still returns no tool list to a caller with no credential. The vendor's MCP page says its tool set splits into public tools available without authentication and authenticated tools; this record, like its predecessor, measures only that one anonymous tools/list returned no list to read that claim against. It exists so that the measurement has a transcript with a sent line, which the 2026-09-21 record lacks; it does not measure what the endpoint does with a credential or why the request was refused.

reproducibility.command: curl -sS -i -m 25 -X POST https://mcp.vercel.com/ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'
